description: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET is the placeholder literal in the file the running control plane loads (apps/react-web/run.sh sources .env.react-web; server/index.mjs:374 passes it to betterAuth). Verified: value equals the literal placeholder, not random.
evidence: node parse of .env.react-web: is_placeholder_literal=true, looks_random=false. server/index.mjs:374 `secret: process.env.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`. PM2 fudrouter-react has no NODE_ENV override, run.sh defaults NODE_ENV=production but does not rotate the secret.
user_impact: Session/cookie signing key is publicly guessable: offline session forgery and full account takeover if the cookie format derives from it.
recommendation: Rotate immediately: `openssl rand -base64 32` into .env.react-web AND .env (both hold the placeholder), `pm2 restart fudrouter-react`, invalidate existing sessions. Do NOT commit the value.
score_impact: Security capped; unresolved P0 caps FINAL at 49. [CLOSED this iteration: secrets unified (match=True, placeholder=False), live process hash d84f26e802a2 == file hash, wrong-password smoke 401 clean JSON, NODE_ENV=production in process.]

description: Workspace privilege escalation: changeRole required only workspace.write with no dominance check, and any in-scope role (incl. builtin rol_owner) was assignable. A builtin admin (workspace.write, no workspace.delete) could promote itself to owner.
evidence: pages.mjs:667-682 before fix: gate mustWorkspace(workspace.write), guard only against changing the owner's own row (:677), role lookup `workspace_id is null or = workspace` (:678) includes rol_owner (0007_platform_backfill.sql:103). rbac.mjs _canAdminister/_guardUser existed but pages.mjs never imported them.
user_impact: Any workspace member with workspace.write could self-promote to owner and gain workspace.delete + billing.write.
recommendation: Applied: owner role grantable only by the owner; non-owners cannot grant permissions they do not hold (actor permission set compared against target role).
score_impact: Fixed during audit; re-verified by code read.

description: No catch-all route: unknown URLs rendered a completely blank page (#root empty, body text length 0, zero h1/links). Users hitting a stale bookmark, typo, or removed page got a dead void with no navigation.
evidence: Browser crawl: /nonexistent-xyz -> h1n:0, links:0, bodyLen:0, rootChildren:0. App.tsx Routes had no path='*' entry. Server returns dist/index.html 200 for the path, client matched nothing.
user_impact: Dead end: no orientation, no recovery, no way back except browser back button.
recommendation: Applied: NotFoundPage (h1 Page not found + Back to home link) at path='*'.
score_impact: Fixed; re-verified: 404-FRESH2 h1=['Page not found'], bodyLen 206.

description: Malformed JSON reached Express's default HTML error page with a server stack trace (file paths, parser internals, body fragment) because NODE_ENV was unset for fudrouter-react and no error middleware existed.
evidence: Before: POST /api/pages/test with {"broken":} -> 400 text/html with SyntaxError stack including /home/dwizzy/fudrouter/node_modules/body-parser paths. After: 400 application/json {"error":"Invalid request body"} with nosniff/DENY/referrer headers. run.sh now defaults NODE_ENV=production; ecosystem.config.cjs sets it for fudrouter-react.
user_impact: Internal paths and framework versions disclosed to any caller; HTML error breaks API clients expecting JSON.
recommendation: Applied: JSON error middleware for /api/* + NODE_ENV=production default in run.sh and ecosystem env.
score_impact: Fixed; re-verified by curl.

description: Zero security headers anywhere in the app (repo-wide grep for CSP/XFO/XCTO/Referrer-Policy/Permissions-Policy/HSTS/helmet: no matches) and Express X-Powered-By left on.
evidence: Before headers: X-Powered-By: Express, no XCTO/XFO/Referrer-Policy. After: X-Powered-By absent, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin (verified by curl -sI). No helmet dependency added; HSTS/CSP intentionally stay at the edge.
user_impact: MIME-sniffing of /assets/*, clickjacking of /login /dashboard /admin, framework fingerprinting.
recommendation: Applied minimal in-app headers; HSTS/CSP remain edge responsibility (Caddy/cloudflared, out of repo).
score_impact: Fixed; re-verified.

description: Public DB-backed aggregate endpoints had no rate limiter (only /api/auth, /api/pages, /api/admin, /api/playground were mounted). Unauthenticated cheap request amplification against Postgres; limiter is also per-process Map (not shared across workers).
evidence: index.mjs:575-578 + 627-629 covered 4 mounts; public.mjs surface (/api/metrics count(*)+avg over request_log, /api/status two 4s upstream fetches, /api/palette six ilike scans) had none. API latency ~32-39ms each, so amplification is cheap.
user_impact: DoS/load vector: one client can hammer DB-heavy aggregates with no per-IP ceiling.
recommendation: Applied: _publicRead 600/min per-IP limiter on all 8 public prefixes. Cross-instance sharing still open (documented, not fixed).
score_impact: Fixed; re-verified routes still 200.

description: better-auth bridge builds its URL from the attacker-controllable Host header (proto from x-forwarded-proto/host), no Host allowlist; trustedOrigins stuck on dev/localhost branch because NODE_ENV was unset, so the deployed origin is not trusted.
evidence: index.mjs:584-586 `const url = proto://host+originalUrl` -> auth.handler(webReq). :404 trustedOrigins NODE_ENV-gated; fudrouter-react had no NODE_ENV (verified via pm2 jlist env).
user_impact: Undermines better-auth origin/redirect checks (reset links, OAuth redirect_uri, CSRF-origin).
recommendation: Partially fixed via NODE_ENV=production (trustedOrigins now takes the production branch []). Full fix needs explicit Host allowlist + ORIGIN-anchored auth URL; left open (edge/Caddy owns Host policy).
score_impact: Downgraded, not closed. [CLOSED this iteration: auth bridge URL anchored to ORIGIN (index.mjs:598), no Host derivation.]

description: SPA fallback served dist/index.html with HTTP 200 for every unknown path including /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml: crawlers got HTML instead of crawler files, and soft-404s told search engines every typo URL is a valid page.
evidence: Before: /robots.txt -> 200 HTML shell; /sitemap.xml -> 200 HTML shell; /nonexistent-xyz -> 200 blank client page. After: /robots.txt real text (Allow + Sitemap), /sitemap.xml 10 URLs, unknown SPA paths still serve shell (correct for SPA) but client renders NotFoundPage.
user_impact: Crawler confusion, index bloat from soft-404s, no sitemap discovery.
recommendation: Applied: /robots.txt + /sitemap.xml routes before the fallback. Server still 200s unknown SPA paths by design (documented).
score_impact: Fixed; re-verified. [severity corrected P1->P2 per re-review]
